challenge.method: Compared the generic and feature-present header bytes. Tested a known 1.3-or-later grant with a single Cover Text, with no features, and with incomplete feature information. Separately tested an entirely unavailable grant, a grant confined to 1.3, and substitution of another numbered base edition.
challenge.results: The two header slices have the same digest. Reading their placeholders as mandatory would erase the distinction made explicitly by the generic entry's comment. All three feature states are compatible with the generic description. An unknown grant cannot establish the edition choice. A single-edition grant and a grant starting at another edition each describe a different choice.

limitations: An unresolved feature choice can be represented generically when the 1.3-or-later grant is established. An unavailable notice alone cannot establish that grant.
